page_title: VEN 1-1 EMP | Venezia v Empoli 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Liam Henderson (Empoli) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
90+3' John Yeboah (Venezia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
88' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
88' Substitution. Luca Marianucci (Empoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Giuseppe Pezzella walks off.
86' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
85' 3:6 – this is the current number of shots on target.
83' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
82' Substitution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) in, Faustino Anjorin out.
81' The ball is cleared after Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
79' The substitution has been made. Junior Sambia (Empoli) has replaced Emmanuel Gyasi.
79' Here is a change. Mattia Viti is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
78' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
75' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
74' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' John Yeboah (Venezia) is caught offside!
73' Total attempts – 4:14.
70' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Gaetano Oristanio is unable to continue due to injury, John Yeboah (Venezia) comes on.
69' The game is interrupted now, Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' A fine pass finds Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Filip Stankovic reacts superbly to deny him.
67' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Venezia was in an offside position.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franco Carboni leaves the pitch and Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) comes on.
64' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) brings his opponent down. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Francesco Zampano (Venezia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
59' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
59' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
56' Mattia Viti (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach easily deals with the threat.
52' Venezia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
49' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
48' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Luca Sacchi who sees an offensive foul.
44' 3:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
42' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach.
41' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
40' Sebastiano Esposito sends the free kick into the box. Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it well wide of the left post.
39' Marin Sverko (Venezia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) swings in a cross from the corner, but Filip Stankovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
37' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
36' There's an opportunity for Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

35' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Filip Stankovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
35' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia).

32' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Lorenzo Colombo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli), who beats Filip Stankovic with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
30' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals NO PENALTY for Empoli after a VAR review!
29' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Empoli! Let's see what he decides.
28' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Empoli for a penalty. Play continues.
27' Dangerous play by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli). Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
26' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) heads on.
26' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
25' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Filip Stankovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
24' Mattia Viti (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
22' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' PENALTY APPEAL by Venezia, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
20' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is penalised for a foul. Juan Luca Sacchi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
18' Some neat passing and movement from Venezia as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
15' The corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is hurriedly cleared.
14' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
14' A snap shot by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Filip Stankovic produces a good save to thwart him.
12' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Francesco Zampano (Venezia).
11' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
8' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
5' 1 - 0 GOAL! Keeper Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
3' The corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is intercepted by Filip Stankovic.
3' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
3' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
2' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
